seats.text:
I implemented `format` in `format.ts`, but I haven't run it or type-checked it, so it is untested.

It follows the README. Doubles are decomposed into an exact mantissa and exponent, and all rounding is done with `BigInt` arithmetic, half-to-even. That should give `%.2f` of 2.675 as `2.67` and `%.0f` of 0.5, 1.5, 2.5 as `0`, `2`, `2`.

It covers all the conversions (`d i x X o e E f F g G s c %%`), the flags, width and precision, and the `inf`/`nan` and `-0` cases. It uses no dependencies and doesn't shell out.
